يضطبن (form VIII)

# يَضْطَبِنَّ (yaḍṭabinna) /jadˤ.tˤa.bin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# يُضْطَبَنُ (yuḍṭabanu) /judˤ.tˤa.ba.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِ
